english: We have been waiting for you, Lord Oja.
chinese: Oja 大人，我们一直在等你。

english: As we served the father, so we'll serve the son.
chinese: 我们怎样效力于父亲，也会怎样效力于儿子。

english: A Dragon Warrior must learn the skills of both a spearman and an archer.
chinese: 神龙武士必须学会长矛兵和弓箭手的本领。

english: Send your spearmen to the archery range.
Send your archers to the dojo.
He goes to take the ancestral keep from the false Serpent.
chinese: 他要从那个假灵蛇手里夺回祖先的要塞。

english: The Wolf clan marches to join him.
chinese: 恶狼族正在进军，与他会合。

english: I would die a hundred deaths for Otomo!
chinese: 为了 Otomo，死多少次我都愿意！

english: Without them, we'll starve when winter comes!
chinese: 没了马匹，冬天一来我们就会饿死！
交易的地方还要往北走。

english: Figures.  Garrin's always favored those foreigners over his own people.
chinese: 果然。Garrin 一向向着外人，胜过自己人。

english: He stays locked up in that house of his and sends Vetkin to do his dirty work.
chinese: 他整天把自己关在那座房子里，让 Vetkin 替他干见不得人的事。

english: Look there!  Vetkin rides for the Wolf clan!
chinese: 看那里！Vetkin 正骑马去找恶狼族！

english: We are yours to command, Lord!
We will do your bidding if you will protect us!
chinese: 只要你保护我们，我们就听你差遣！

english: Who owns the house on the hill?
He calls himself a Lord now?
But money...ah, money is what truly makes a man.
chinese: 可金子……啊，有了金子才算个人物。
也许还能造就更多人物。

english: Men who might refuse to fight for Garrin if anything were to...happen.
chinese: 要是 Garrin 出了什么事，他们或许就不肯再替他作战。

english: The Serpent walks where he likes.
chinese: 灵蛇想去哪里就去哪里。
这里曾是灵蛇族的土地。

english: Or you could fight for me instead.
chinese: 或者你也可以替我作战。

english: When I sit on the Serpent's throne, the faithful will be well rewarded.
chinese: 等我坐上灵蛇的王座，忠诚的人必得厚礼。

english: I want to talk to you!
Good, because I have a task for you.
chinese: 很好，因为我有事要你办。

english: Come - let's skin the rest of these scruffy wolves.
chinese: 来，杀掉剩下的恶狼族，取下他们的皮。

english: Or have you forgotten the Serpent clan already?
chinese: 还是说，你已经忘了灵蛇族？
你们这些僧人现在为我效力。
你们的圣地现在在哪里？

english: Your holy ground is where I walk and where I sleep.
chinese: 我走过、休息过的地方，就是你们的圣地。

english: I am your holy ground, and you will hold me as dear as you did that pile of rubble over there.
chinese: 我就是你们的圣地。你们要像爱那边那堆破石头一样爱我。
那就把你的兄弟们召集起来。

english: Get to the Orb at all costs!
chinese: 不惜一切代价夺下宝珠！

english: You fool - you don't know what you've done!
chinese: 无知的人，你根本不知道自己做了什么！

english: I'm not afraid of the dark.
